newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet to discuss Kopex trader flotation.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet to discuss Kopex trader flotation.

text.p: The Polish government will discuss a plan on Tuesday to float at least 25 percent of shares in the mining machinery trader Kopex SA, the government spokeswoman said.
"The plan provides for offering at least 25 percent of Kopex' shares," Aleksandra Jakubowska told a news briefing without elaborating.
Kopex' turnover reached $100 million last year. No further financial data on the company was immediately available.
